title: Gestão De Projetos, Marketing E Operações
description:
Overview

Estou buscando por um(a) Gestor(a) de Projetos com perfil ágil, organizado e versátil para me apoiar na gestão e operação de três negócios distintos: design, bebidas experimentais e imóveis.

A função envolve atuar no dia a dia desses projetos organizando tarefas, acompanhando entregas, negociando com fornecedores e ajudando a manter tudo em andamento. É essencial ter boa comunicação escrita, inclusive em inglês (leitura e escrita), familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos como Notion ou ClickUp, e disposição para lidar com frentes variadas; desde o acompanhamento de entregas de design para clientes internacionais até o suporte para a organização de um projeto de reforma de um imóvel, operação de uma microindústria de bebidas ou manutenção de uma campanha de anúncios.

A função envolverá também atuação direta para garantir que as coisas aconteçam de ponta a ponta : orçar, comprar, agendar, organizar cronogramas, negociar com fornecedores, atualizar planilhas, resolver pendências e destravar o que for preciso.

É fundamental que a pessoa tenha facilidade real para aprender coisas novas e complexas, com raciocínio rápido e capacidade de entender contextos variados com profundidade. Muitos dos projetos envolvem temas técnicos diversos e pouco padronizados, que exigem agilidade para pesquisar, interpretar e aplicar informações com autonomia. Busco alguém com inteligência prática, curiosidade ativa e flexibilidade para navegar entre assuntos distintos, aprendendo rapidamente o uso de ferramentas e processos de acordo com novos desafios.

Funções em cada frente de atuação

Design (Bas-Alto)

Estúdio de design com atuação internacional (apenas clientes estrangeiros, em inglês) em projetos de identidade visual, website e product design.

  • Comunicação escrita com clientes e parceiros (em inglês) para acompanhamento de projetos.
  • Delegação, briefing e hand-off de tarefas para o time de designers;
  • Acompanhamento de entregas em projetos simultâneos.

Bebidas (Caêm do Brasil)

Microindústria de sidras e bebidas fermentadas com sede em Curitiba.

caembrasil.com.br | instagram.com / caembrasil

  • Gerenciamento de campanhas de marketing, tráfego pago e vendas;
  • Apoio em lançamentos e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Participação em reuniões semanais com a equipe para priorização e delegação de tarefas;
  • Apoio administrativo, financeiro e operacional do negócio.

Negócios Imobiliários

Micro incorporadora focada em house flipping e construção de casas modernistas em Belo Horizonte.

  • Apoio geral na organização e logística de reformas e obras;
  • Acompanhamento dos projetos com as equipes responsáveis;
  • Organização de planilhas e sistemas como Notion e Google Sheets.

Requisitos e perfil profissional

  • Proatividade real e pique de fazer acontecer;
  • Agilidade para mover entre contextos variados e mergulhar em novos desafios;
  • Organização e experiência com gerenciamento de projetos;
  • Facilidade em aprender novas ferramentas ou se aprofundar em tópicos variados;
  • Clareza na escrita e na comunicação;
  • Inglês fluente (leitura e escrita);

Diferenciais

  • Interesse ou experiência no mundo do design, marketing, produtos digitais, arquitetura ou bebidas;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas como Notion, planilhas e sistemas de produtividade;
  • Entendimento de processos de design e experiência com ferramentas da área, como o Figma.

Formato

  • Carga horária integral, com horários flexíveis;
  • Trabalho 100% remoto, com preferência para quem reside em Curitiba ou Belo Horizonte - mas não necessário;
  • Remuneração: entre R$3.000 a R$5.000+, conforme o nível de senioridade e autonomia prática;

Se tiver um interesse especial pela vaga, sinta-se aberto(a) para enviar um e-mail para contando mais sobre você (não obrigatório).

Overview

Oportunidade – Arquiteto(a) de Dados | Governança | Databricks | Snowflake | Inglês Avançado

Local: Remoto (empresa em São Paulo / SP)

Nível: Sênior

Idioma: Inglês Avançado (C2)

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar e manter modelos de dados eficientes, confiáveis e escaláveis em Databricks e Snowflake para suporte a KPIs e análises avançadas.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders para traduzir requisitos de negócios em conjuntos de dados robustos, garantindo consistência, precisão e governança.
  • Otimizar pipelines ELT e transformações SQL para desempenho e manutenibilidade.
  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados com regras de validação, documentação e processos de monitoramento.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de Analytics e BI para entender as necessidades analíticas.
  • Atuar junto aos engenheiros de dados para aprimorar a arquitetura, design de esquemas e ajustes de performance em ambientes de nuvem.

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • 5 anos de experiência em engenharia analítica, modelagem de dados ou funções relacionadas.
  • Sólida proficiência em SQL.
  • Experiência com Databricks e Snowflake (ou plataformas de dados modernas semelhantes).
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados (esquema em estrela, normalização, processamento incremental).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração ETL / ELT e versionamento (dbt, Airflow, Git).
  • Atenção aos detalhes e foco em documentação e qualidade de dados.
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação técnica.

Diferenciais

title: Neuroscience Sales Specialist - Scranton, PA
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Position Summary The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

Position Levels

  • Sales Specialist: $115,000.00 - requires 1+ years of sales experience with at least 1 year in pharmaceutical, and/or other related healthcare sales, with an emphasis on neuroscience preferred.
  • Sales Specialist: $135,000.00 - requires a minimum of 5+ years of healthcare sales with at least 2 years of experience in complex or account-based selling environments is required.

PERM Project Manager

LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.

Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo!

A EasyJur é uma Legaltech que tem como missão revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio da inteligência humana e artificial. Sabemos que construímos algo que é genuinamente útil para as pessoas : todo advogado ou advogada que adota o #easyjur como sua solução central tem percebido rapidamente os benefícios gerados pela transformação digital.

Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!

O que a gente espera de você?

O BDR será responsável pela prospecção ativa de novos clientes, focando na geração de oportunidades em mercados ainda não explorados pela EasyJur. Este papel é crucial para a expansão da nossa presença no mercado jurídico brasileiro, abrindo portas para novos relacionamentos comerciais de alto valor.

Somos um time "mão na massa", guiados por coragem, disciplina e integridade. Se você tem sede por desafios, é movido por resultados e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que está moldando o futuro da advocacia, seu lugar é aqui com a gente!

  • Prospectar ativamente escritórios de advocacia de médio e grande porte, através de cold calls, e-mails e redes sociais;
  • Qualificar leads outbound identificando dores, necessidades e potencial de aderência às soluções EasyJur;

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing para otimizar campanhas de prospecção;
  • Colaborar com times de Vendas, Produto e CS para feedbacks e melhoria contínua.

  • Experiência prévia como SDR / BDR ou em áreas de prospecção / vendas outbound;

  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e persuasiva;

  • Familiaridade com o setor jurídico ou venda de software B2B é um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento prático sobre desafios de escritórios de advocacia (fluxo de trabalho, captação de clientes, gestão de prazos);
  • Participação em bootcamps ou treinamentos de vendas outbound.

O que você pode esperar de nós :

  • Aqui você vai encontrar um time comprometido em trabalhar em alta performance e a entregar resultados acima da média;
  • Um ambiente dinâmico além do padrão de empresas tradicionais e hierarquias verticais;
  • Aqui quebramos o paradigma de "manda quem pode e obedece quem tem juízo";
  • Temos como meta diária empoderar as pessoas e potencializar talentos.

Além disso é claro, oferecemos :

  • Plano de Saúde (Unimed);
  • Auxílio Maternidade / Paternidade;
  • Day off em seu aniversário;
  • Day off colaborador destaque do mês;
  • Day off em seu aniversário de empresa;

  • Bolsa para especializações e estudos;
  • Auxilio de 50% em atividades físicas como : academias e outros esportes.
  • Frutas frescas e café da manhã todos os dias (sede Uberaba);

  • Bônus por indicação de novos colaboradores e / ou prestadores de serviços.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

title: Consultor(a) de Vendas Inside Sales | RJ, SP ou BH
description:
Consultor(a) de Vendas Inside Sales | RJ, SP ou BH

Somos aliados do médico durante toda a sua jornada e buscamos por pessoas que se identifiquem com nosso propósito, valores e cultura para se juntarem ao nosso time. Vamos juntos transformar a saúde com quem tem a medicina como vocação!

Esta é uma vaga aberta na frente de Graduação, para trabalhar de forma remota.

Ao assumir o cargo de Consultor de Vendas na Afya, tem como objetivo principal realizar o atendimento dos leads gerados, buscando um atendimento personalizado contribuindo para uma experiência positiva dos nossos clientes.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

  • Realizar o atendimento dos leads gerados, com acolhimento, cordialidade e empatia. Preferencialmente via telefone e pelos demais canais de comunicação utilizados na empresa (para atendimento da solicitação do aluno para realização da venda);
  • Aplicar técnicas de vendas (SPIN Selling, senso de urgência e escassez);
  • Identificar carteira de vendas que será trabalhada("negócios" e "tarefa")
  • Realizar identificação correta das leads no histórico da Papeline e realizar tentativa de contato na ordem correta do funil de vendas;
  • Conhecer com propriedade o produto, ofertas e desconto regressivo
  • Estar atualizado com a estratégica da concorrência
  • Agir em conformidade aos requisitos legais e adaptação as normas internas, por meio da participação efetiva nos treinamentos e relato de possíveis desafios, zelando pelo sigilo das informações, conforme código de ética Afya e LGPD;
  • Interagir e negociar com os futuros clientes de forma personalizada (entendendo o perfil, a dor e a necessidades de cada um) adequando da melhor forma os nossos cursos de acordo com a necessidade dos clientes, visando a conversão e a satisfação dos mesmos, bem como, o atingimento das metas do setor;
  • Garantir resposta rápida e assertiva ao cliente interessado, registrando todas as atividades realizadas tais como e-mails e ligações no sistema CRM, mantendo assim controle do relacionamento com o cliente;
  • Manter follow-up das oportunidades e contatos realizados, (através de tarefas do CRM utilizado e ferramentas do Whatsapp Business buscando maior efetividade nas vendas.

O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Ensino médio completo , desejável cursando superior;
  • Desejável conhecimento em venda de cursos na área da educação;
  • Técnicas de negociação;
  • Técnicas de Vendas (Metodologia SPIN Selling).
  • Foco em resultados;
  • Comunicação verbal e escrita assertiva;
  • Disponibilidade para atuação nos seguintes horários: Serão Segunda a Sexta-feira de 09:00h às 15:00h ou de 14:00h às 20:00h.

️ GENTE É O MELHOR DA GENTE, por isso, oferecemos benefícios e parcerias para o nosso time.

Confira os principais abaixo:

Para o dia a dia:

  • Vale-alimentação / refeição;
  • Flexibilidade de horários e alocações (para vagas Remotas);
  • Vale-transporte (para vagas Hibridas ou Presenciais);

UP na remuneração:

  • Multibenefícios: Benefício flexível via Cartão Flash para usar como preferir.
  • Gympass / Wellhub;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Licença parental estendida (até 6 meses para mães e 20 dias para pais);
  • Rede D'Ór: suporte e informações importantes para a saúde da mamãe e do bebê com uma rede credenciada de enfermeiros;
  • Parceria com o SESC da sua região (programação variada nas áreas de educação, saúde, cultura, lazer e assistência);
  • Day Off de Aniversário (um dia de folga para tirar no dia ou durante o mês do seu aniversário).

Desenvolvimento e Aprendizado:

  • Plataforma com diversos cursos para aprimorar seu conhecimento (UCA);
  • Programa de desenvolvimento para líderes;
  • Mentoria para Mulheres da Afya (MMA);
  • Desconto em cursos de graduação e pós-graduação nas unidades de ensino da Afya.

Diferencial para Professor Médico:

  • Step 3: Etapa Atração 3 Etapa Atração

O MAIOR HUB DE EDUCAÇÃO E TECNOLOGIAS PARA A PRÁTICA MÉDICA DO BRASIL.

A marca Afya nasceu em 2019, mas nossa história começou muito antes. Surgimos da união entre a NRE Educacional, maior grupo de faculdades de Medicina do país, fundado em 1999, com a MEDCEL, marca de cursos preparatórios para prova de residência médica.

Com o nosso crescimento acelerado, adquirimos nos últimos anos novas unidades de ensino — já são mais de 30 espalhadas pelo Brasil — e mais de 10 startups que oferecem soluções digitais para a prática médica — Afya Whitebook, Afya iClinic, Afya Papers, Glic e Cliquefarma são algumas marcas do nosso portfólio. Acesse afya.com.br para conhecer mais sobre a nossa história e todas as soluções que oferecemos.

A Afya é uma companhia de capital aberto desde 2019, com ações negociadas na bolsa de valores Nasdaq, nos Estados Unidos. Em 2023 disponibilizamos nossas ações também na bolsa brasileira, a B3. Saiba mais sobre esse assunto em ir.afya.com.br .

Nosso propósito é transformar a saúde em conjunto com quem tem a medicina como vocação. Para isso, contamos com um time de 10 mil pessoas curiosas, parceiras, comprometidas, adaptáveis e realizadoras. Gente de todos os cantos do Brasil, com diferentes sotaques, mas falando a mesma língua, unida pelo mesmo propósito. Se você se identifica com o jeito Afya de ser, vem com a gente transformar a saúde com educação e tecnologia . #VemSerAfya

title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us

About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

What we are looking for in you

  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines

What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Job Description
A Nova Escola tem a missão de fortalecer os educadores para transformar a educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.
A Nova Escola é um negócio social de Educação e a marca mais reconhecida por professores de Educação Básica no Brasil.
Nossa missão é fortalecer educadores para transformar a Educação pública brasileira e possibilitar que os alunos desenvolvam o máximo do seu potencial.
Desenvolvemos produtos, serviços e conteúdos que valorizam os professores, facilitam seu dia-a-dia e apoiam sua carreira. Nosso principal mantenedor é a Fundação Lemann e realizamos parcerias com diversas organizações como Google.org, Facebook, Fundação Itaú Social, Imaginable Futures, Governo Britânico, secretarias de educação e outras organizações que nos ajudam nesse desafio.
64% dos professores brasileiros utilizam nossos planos de aula todos os meses, além disso temos 3 milhões de visitantes únicos por mês em nossa plataforma e cerca de 1,8 milhões de seguidores em nossas redes sociais, o que nos permite conhecer bem nosso público.
Valorizamos a diversidade no ambiente de trabalho e estamos buscando tornar a Nova Escola ainda mais diversa. As nossas vagas são destinadas a todos!
Responsibilities and assignments
Criamos o Banco de Talentos da Nova Escola para que profissionais que tenham o desejo de transformar a educação junto com a gente, possam demonstrar o seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso nosso negócio.
Caso não tenha encontrado nenhuma vaga de acordo com seu perfil, deixe seu currículo cadastrado em neste Banco de Talentos, acompanhe as divulgações e mantenha seus dados profissionais atualizados, pois quando tivermos uma vaga que faça sentido para o seu perfil, poderemos entrar em contato!
Desde já agradecemos seu interesse em fazer parte do nosso time!
Additional information
O que oferecemos

  • Contratação CLT com flexibilidade de horário
  • Participação nos Resultados da Empresa (até 2 salários nominais)
  • Plano de Saúde Amil (apartamento) 90% para funcionários + 50% para dependentes
  • Licença estendida de maternidade e paternidade
  • Vale Refeição - Sodexo
  • Auxílio creche (até 7 anos)
  • Aulas de Inglês (na empresa)
  • Recesso de fim de ano (10 dias de folga)
Devido a pandemia do COVID-19, atualmente estamos trabalhando em modelo de home office. Esperamos em breve voltar para nosso escritório, no bairro de Pinheiros, em São Paulo, quando tudo estiver seguro para esta volta. Nosso escritório se encontra em uma região de fácil acesso (metrô e ônibus) e também com várias opções de restaurantes, lazer e esporte.
Faça parte do time que está transformando a Educação pública do país!

Sentimos orgulho das nossas soluções serem baseadas em dados e evidências, desenvolvidas a partir e junto daqueles que vivenciam diariamente a realidade da educação pública brasileira. Estamos unidos com os professores por uma causa comum: oferecer um ensino de qualidade para todos os alunos do nosso país.
Autonomia para ir além: Somos inquietos, dispostos a arriscar, dialogar e reinventar. Criamos novos formatos, melhoramos os existentes, mantendo o foco nos educadores. Assumimos riscos, testamos novas soluções, aprendemos com os erros e medimos nosso impacto. Com essa confiança e autonomia, podemos concentrar nossos esforços no propósito que nos move.
Busca pela Excelência: Nosso time está comprometido a buscar a excelência em tudo que faz para atingir a missão da Nova Escola. Exigimos de nós mesmos um trabalho de qualidade e melhoria contínua. Procuramos, a partir de nossas especialidades, aprender continuamente sobre a Educação Pública.

Gerenciamos pessoas, parceiros e recursos para desenvolver soluções que geram impacto na educação. Mantemos uma atitude ética, respeitosa, acolhedora e proativa para inspirar uma mudança na sociedade. Nossa atuação é suprapartidária e livre de interesses pessoais na sociedade.
Diálogo transparente: Promovemos um ambiente onde todos se sentem à vontade para fazer perguntas e buscar esclarecimentos abertamente. Incentivamos a comunicação direta e transparente e valorizamos o diálogo produtivo. Acreditamos que a coragem para expressar dúvidas e compartilhar ideias fortalece nossa colaboração e aprimorar nossos processos.

title: Technology and Product Senior Software Engineer | CARE Brazil (Remote)
description:
Overview

Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in 11 countries, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to our CARE - Deep Individual Data team in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We are looking for a passionate and skilled Software Engineer to join our team and help us build solutions by providing high-quality data to improve Wellhub’s products and provide partner data to all areas of the company.

You will join a team responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive database of information on our existing and potential partners. This includes discovering and collecting data from various sources and formats (text, photo, video, audio), processing and enriching this data, and transforming it into actionable insights that enhance partner content, user recommendations, business intelligence, and the overall quality of our platform. We expect all candidates to be avid learners, team workers, and not afraid to fail fast and try again.

Your Impact

You will be working in one or more of the following areas:

  • HTTP requests
  • HTML parsing
  • Dynamic scraping
  • Optical Character Recognition (OCR)
  • Third-Party API Integration
    • REST APIs (authentication via tokens, OAuth, etc.)
    • Google Places API
    • Meta (Facebook Graph API)
    • OpenStreetMap (Nominatim, Overpass API)
  • Data Processing & Transformation
    • Data handling and cleaning
    • Data validation and modeling
  • Testing & Quality Assurance
    • Unit and integration testing
    • Mocking external APIs
  • API Development and Integration:
    • Design and develop APIs.
    • Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, and performant.
    • Ensure seamless integration with other software systems, enhancing interoperability and functionality (e.g., WhatsApp, Slack, Teams, Google Chat, and other 3rd party mobile applications).
  • Collaboration and Communication:
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers.
    • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.
    • Communicate technical concepts and project progress effectively to non-technical stakeholders.

Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong skills in programming languages such as Python, Go.
  • Experienced in working with SQL/NoSQL technologies (e.g., OpenSearch, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL) understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls.
  • Experienced in working with message queues & async processing (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Experience with API development and integration.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Able to work efficiently on highly scalable and distributed projects.
  • Proven experience with projects with a more experimental scope.
  • Fast learner, easily adapting to new technologies.
  • Passionate and proven experience to build reliable minimum viable products and pilots.

Good to have:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience with one or more topics listed above.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience with Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration.

What We Offer You

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

  • WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.
  • WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.
  • HEALTHCARE : Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.
  • PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp back period to return part-time while they get settled.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.
  • CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

description:
Overview

Senior Sales Consultant for Small Legal

Founded in 2003, ProSites now helps over 20,000 professionals with their online marketing needs. The company is comprised of four brands, all of which provide website design and online marketing solutions to professional markets. We have over 300 team members across 4 offices and are part of the Rock Family of Companies (Rockbridge Growth Equity LLC). ProSites, Inc. has been recognized on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for 2012, voted #1 in website design and services, and on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies for six years. Since 2004, ProSites has served professionals across North America, including in the fields of Dental, Legal, Animal Health, and Accounting. Our marketing solutions include Website Design, SEO, PPC, Social Media, Content Marketing and Practice Solution Software.

ProSites is adding to our team of Digital Marketing, Sales Consultants. We are seeking a few driven individuals to join our sales team in the areas of Hunting/Prospecting/New Business Development.

Responsibilities

  • Hunting/Prospecting/New Business Development
    • Follow up on leads, target prospects using our extensive database, develop a pipeline and close new business by providing our suite of website solutions.
    • Identify key decision-makers to initiate the sales process, close business via the phone/email.
    • Meet/exceed monthly, quarterly and annual sales quotas.

Basic Functions

The Senior Sales Consultant is responsible for outbound prospecting calls and selling ProSites portfolio of website design and internet marketing solutions, while meeting or exceeding sales quotas. Successful candidates will have previous experience as a top producer making outbound prospecting calls, establishing and maintaining client relationships, identifying potential new clients and opportunities, managing a sales funnel and closing sales with decision makers.

  • Persistent and able to handle rejection
  • Thrive on success with a positive attitude
  • Ability to adapt to change
  • Experience in a competitive fast-paced sales environment
  • Excellent social skills and desire to excel
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills
  • High level of comfort with internet technology
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Motivated to be part of a fast-moving, entrepreneurial team
  • Ability to provide clear written documentation using MS Office and CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce, MS Dynamics, NetSuite)
  • Comfortable serving and interacting with business owners in Dental, Veterinary, Accounting or Legal practices
  • Balance a customer service approach with a sales approach
  • Long-term career focus; many sales consultants have been here a decade or longer
  • Driven to succeed in a high commission environment
  • Persistent and able to handle objections professionally
  • Thrives in a self-directed, self-driven sales environment
  • Comfortable working remotely

Key Skills, Abilities, and Qualifications

  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial attitude and growth mindset
  • Ability to provide clear and comprehensive written documentation using MS Office
  • Ability to provide high quality communication that is respectful and professional
  • Passion for building relationships, understanding business and serving others
  • Experience with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce.com, HubSpot, MS Dynamics, NetSuite)

  • Coachability and willingness to learn from peers

Physical/Mental Requirements for the Job

description:
Overview

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance. At Tether, we’re building products to power a global financial revolution. Our solutions enable businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. We provide fast, secure, and global digital token transfer with a focus on transparency and trust.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, trusted by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside digital asset tokenization services.

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with solutions like KEET, our flagship app for secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning to empower individuals in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: Pushing the boundaries of what is possible at the intersection of technology and human potential.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from around the world. If you’re passionate about fintech and want to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, this is your opportunity to push boundaries and set new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and established ourselves as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We are seeking a skilled Talent Sourcer (AI and Technology) for a 6-month contract to join our global team. In this role, you will identify and engage top talent worldwide with a strong focus on AI and technology profiles. You will work closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand business needs, drive sourcing strategies, and connect with the best candidates in the market.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Recruiters to understand hiring needs and role requirements across multiple departments.
  • Source, identify, and engage passive and active candidates via platforms such as LinkedIn, job boards, internal databases, and Boolean search techniques.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.
  • Maintain and update candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and ensure a smooth handoff to recruiters.
  • Collaborate with employer branding and marketing teams to promote opportunities and improve candidate engagement.
  • Track sourcing metrics and provide regular reports and insights to stakeholders to improve strategy.
  • Stay informed on market trends, salary benchmarks, and competitive intelligence to support talent mapping.
  • 3-5 years of sourcing or recruitment experience, preferably in a fast-paced or tech environment.
  • Experience sourcing AI is mandatory.
  • Knowledge of talent markets in APAC, EMEA, MENA and Americas.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong research and online sourcing skills (Boolean search, X-ray, LinkedIn Recruiter, etc.).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Spanish is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ATS tools e.g. Recruitee.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple open roles and shifting priorities.
  • Proactive, resourceful, and data-driven in approach.

Important information for candidates

  • Apply only through official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on the official careers page: tether.recruitee.com
  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If unsure, confirm via their profile or our official website.
  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is through official company emails and platforms.
  • Double-check email addresses. Communications will come from emails ending in tether.to or tether.io.
  • We will never request payment or financial details. If asked for personal financial information during hiring, it is a scam—please report it.

When in doubt, reach out through our official website.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager (Germany) — Exhibitions
description:
Our Mission

Swapcard is the leading AI-powered event platform designed to drive revenue growth and foster meaningful connections at in-person and hybrid events. We recognize the importance of teamwork in successful events; that's why Swapcard is fueled by a team of innovators who are passionate about helping organizers build future-proof events.

Our Vision

At Swapcard, we believe in the power of meaningful connections. This belief fuels our commitment to pioneering modern solutions that empower organizers to create engaging event experiences.

Guided by our commitment to excellence and collaboration, we aim to redefine the landscape of event technology, setting new standards for engagement, accessibility, and impact.

Our Beliefs

At Swapcard, diversity is at the core of our success. With 42 nationalities represented among our 180+ team members, we champion diversity as a catalyst for creativity, collaboration, and unparalleled innovation.

We believe that by embracing a multitude of backgrounds, cultures, and viewpoints, we can truly understand and cater to the needs of our global community of event organizers and participants.

Our full remote opportunities empower our team to thrive, no matter where they are in the world, fostering a culture of flexibility and inclusion.

Responsibilities

  • Activate your Messe network to open doors with exhibition organisers and Tier-1 exhibitors; secure warm introductions to show directors, exhibitor sales leads, and commercial heads across major German fairs.
  • Territory mapping of organiser groups and exhibitor accounts; keep CRM and account plans crisp, and coordinate resources to deliver on client goals.
  • Outbound & pipeline development with credibility-led relationship building—grounded in an understanding of organiser/exhibitor objectives and show economics.
  • Market education & evangelism : share best practices, trends and benchmarks aligned to Swapcard’s solutions; represent us at key industry events and fairs.
  • Value-led selling : uncover and interpret prospect needs; align solutions to business outcomes (revenue, exhibitor satisfaction, data, operations) rather than features.
  • Sales excellence : adopt and evolve best practices; leverage systems for efficiency while delivering standout buying experiences.
  • Product & ecosystem fluency : develop strong working knowledge of Swapcard, event-tech stacks, and organiser workflows (exhibitor sales, operations, marketing).
  • Forecasting & deal hygiene : maintain reliable forecasts and transparent deal reviews; build references and feed actionable inputs to the roadmap.
  • Travel in DACH/Germany to be on-site with organisers and at key shows.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in SaaS or B2B solutions sales, closing enterprise deals.
  • 3+ years in the Event/Exhibition industry, with direct experience selling to or working within Messe organisers.
  • Proven, current network in Germany’s exhibition ecosystem—you can name and reach show leaders and exhibitor sales teams of the German exhibitions organisers (Messes)
  • Track record of quota attainment in fast-paced environments; skilled in advanced discovery, multi-threading, and negotiation.
  • Executive presence & C-level access: comfortable engaging CEOs/MDs, portfolio directors, and commercial heads at organisers and large exhibitors.
  • Exceptional communication (written, storytelling, presenting) and phone/video comfort.
  • Fluent in German and English; additional languages a plus.

title: LCA Lead | Life Cycle Analysis Lead
description:
About InPlanet

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.
People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.
We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

Key Responsibilities

LCA Development & Execution

  • Conduct full Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) for mining, rock sourcing, transportation, and field spreading processes .
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards , GHG Protocols, IPCC guidelines, and relevant carbon accounting frameworks .
  • Quantify the carbon footprint and co-benefits of InPlanet’s Enhanced Rock Weathering projects for emissions avoidance and reductions linked to changes in agronomic practices.

Scalability & Process Optimization

  • Develop scalable LCA methodologies to streamline assessment processes across multiple projects.
  • Integrate automation tools where possible to reduce manual data collection bottlenecks .
  • Identify opportunities for emissions reduction in our supply chain and propose actionable sustainability strategies.

Carbon Reporting & Certification

  • Produce Greenhouse Gas (GHG) statements and carbon accounting reports to support MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification) requirements .
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align LCA outputs with carbon credit certification needs .

Stakeholder & Data Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with mines and supply chain partners to facilitate accurate and timely data collection.
  • Coordinate with farmers and supply chain teams to ensure high-quality input data .
  • Troubleshoot data gaps when mines or other partners do not provide necessary information (e.g. secondary mine process data).

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work cross-functionally to ensure that LCA insights inform strategic decision-making at InPlanet.
  • Present findings to internal teams and external partners, communicating complex sustainability assessments in a clear and actionable manner .

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes.
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency.
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change.

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience with LCA methodologies and tools (e.g., SimaPro, OpenLCA, GaBi , or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with ISO 14040/14044 LCA standards and/or GHG accounting protocols .
  • 7+ years of experience in carbon accounting and sustainability impact assessments .
  • Knowledge of mining, agriculture, or supply chain sustainability is a strong plus.
  • Ability to structure LCAs for scalability in a fast-growing company.
Key Qualities
  • High attention to detail —accuracy in sustainability reporting is critical.
  • Solution-oriented mindset —doesn’t just point out gaps, but proposes fixes and optimisations.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Driven and resilient —pushes forward despite data collection challenges.
  • Comfortable with uncertainty —navigates the evolving landscape of carbon markets with adaptability.
Bonus Points (but not essential)
  • Certified LCA Practitioner (ACLCA)
  • Greenhouse Gas Accounting Certification (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064)
  • Certified Carbon Auditor
  • ISO 14040/14044 LCA Training

Benefits

  • Salary expectations and our comp philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. Competitive.
  • Share options (ESOP) to make you feel like an owner.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 34+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference, and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

About the Role

Location: Brazil (Preferably near São Paulo)
Languages: Fluent in Portuguese & English

At InPlanet, we are pioneering the use of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a scalable carbon removal solution. To ensure the credibility and scientific rigor of our impact, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) plays a critical role in evaluating the full environmental footprint of our operations—from rock sourcing to CO₂ sequestration.
As our LCA Lead, you will spearhead the development and execution of LCAs for our ongoing and future projects. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Science, Operations, Carbon Accounting, and Business Development—to navigate complex sustainability frameworks, structure LCA methodologies for scalability, and produce reliable greenhouse gas (GHG) assessments that feed into our carbon credit issuance process.
This is a high-impact role at the core of our mission. If you're passionate about climate solutions and have a track record of data-driven sustainability analysis, we’d love to have you on board.

The Impact You Can Make

  • Develop and execute high-quality LCAs to quantify the environmental footprint of our supply chain, from rock mining to field application.
  • Establish scalable methodologies and refine LCA frameworks that can be applied efficiently across multiple geographies and project types.
  • Enable InPlanet to meet the strictest carbon market standards , ensuring credibility in the issuance of high-quality carbon removal credits.
  • Strengthen our network by building trust with mining and farming stakeholders , optimising data collection, and improving transparency.
  • Support the integration of LCA insights into business decisions , helping to shape strategic choices around material sourcing, transportation, and field deployment.

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.
The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.
These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 8 hours across 3-7 weeks from CV screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)
  • (optional third interview)
  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Potential in-person follow-up interview.
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How to Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

Being an equal opportunities employer is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

title: Payment Operations Lead
description:
Overview

About Owner.com

Owner is the all-in-one platform that restaurants use to succeed online.

Thousands of restaurant owners use our tools to build their website, drive online orders, create their own branded app, manage their customer relationships, and set up marketing automations.

You can think of it as Shopify meets HubSpot, but specifically for restaurants.

Learn more about the problems we are solving for our customers here.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants–we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

In just over 3 years we\'ve generated tens of millions in revenue, served millions of guests, and processed hundreds of millions of online orders.

More importantly, we’ve helped thousands of restaurant owners save their businesses - and not only survive, but thrive.

Our team

Our team grew from under 100 to nearly 200 talented people in 2024. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2025 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Why we’re looking for you

Owner.com is building the all-in-one platform that helps independent restaurants grow and thrive. Payments are core to our mission - restaurants depend on us to reliably process tens of millions of online orders today. We’re looking for a Payment Operations Lead to design and scale our payments operations, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and reliability as we expand from U.S-based restaurants into international markets.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

The impact you will have

  • Design and implement scalable payment operations processes and controls, ensuring reliable reconciliation, dispute handling, and settlement.
  • Oversee operational risk management (onboarding reviews, transaction monitoring, chargebacks) and partner with Product/Analytics on risk model improvements.
  • Monitor and improve payment performance metrics (approval rates, chargeback ratios, settlement timeliness) to enhance merchant trust and retention.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering and Analytics to automate operational workflows, reduce manual intervention, and embed ops requirements into product design.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance and risk management as Owner.com evolves its payments infrastructure and prepares for new markets and payments channels.
  • Collaborate closely with Support to improve merchant experiences and streamline escalations.
  • Develop operational playbooks, dashboards, and reporting to provide visibility into performance and risk.
  • Lead remediation of operational incidents and drive continuous improvement.
  • Over time, hire and grow a high-performing Payment Operations team.

Who you’ll work with

  • Report directly to the GM of Payments and partner with leadership to shape Owner.com\’s payments strategy, expanding beyond online ordering into additional payment channels and technologies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support teams to embed and scale payments across the platform.
  • Align with Finance and Compliance on reconciliation, reporting, and regulatory needs.

What we’re looking for

  • 5–10 years of experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or payment operations roles.
  • Direct experience with platform payments or marketplace models (Stripe, Adyen, or similar).
  • Strong understanding of payment performance levers (fraud, chargebacks, approval optimization, settlement) and regulatory frameworks (KYC/KYB, AML, PCI, card network rules).
  • Hands-on experience in operational risk management, including onboarding risk, transaction monitoring, and chargeback processes.
  • Proven ability to design scalable processes, implement controls, and own operational metrics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and data analysis skills; comfortable using tools/SQL to dive into payments data.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional collaboration skills with Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance.
  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring a team, with readiness and excitement to roll up sleeves as an individual contributor in the short term.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: thrives in ambiguity, adapts quickly, and takes ownership to drive outcomes.

Pay and benefits

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $65,000 - $85,000, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package
  • Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure , we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : \"work smart\", \"overdeliver\", \"speed is king\" and \"better everyday\". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn\'t it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.
